text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to amend the existing by-law authorizing the installation of speed humps on McRoberts Avenue to accommodate one additional speed hump.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the installation of one additional speed hump on McRoberts Avenue, between Kitchener Avenue and Keith Avenue. 2. Replaced Drawing "EY08-46, March 2008" with Drawing "EY18-070, June 2018", attached to the report (May 22, 2018) from the Director, Transportation Services, Etobicoke York District.
